findings.impact: The load-time invariant this PR states as its own operational discipline (throw loudly, never fabricate/degrade silently) is unverified by any executing test or CI step. A future change that regresses it -- e.g. a well-meaning 'don't crash the worker' catch that falls back to an empty/stale roster, or a mapping regression in roster-seed-generator.ts's skip logic -- would ship with a fully green CI (bun test discovers zero relevant tests; no workflow references roster/loadV0Roster/validateRoster). Blast radius is bounded to the periodic projects-discovery worker job (not API/demo boot, confirmed via the single caller above), and the committed artifact currently loads and validates correctly (manually verified: `bun -e` against loadV0Roster() loaded 1037 projects with checksum passing), so there is no live incident -- only an unguarded regression path for the specific discipline the PR's own comments commit to.
findings.recommendation: Add bun:test coverage (backend/tests/ or colocated) exercising: loadV0Roster() success against the committed artifact; missing-data-file and missing-manifest-file throws; corrupt-JSON throw; each validateRoster structural/count/checksum mismatch throw; and mapV0RosterRows()'s skip/mapping branches (duplicate slug, missing required fields, unlinked project_id, zero-project refusal in generateV0RosterArtifact). Wire it into the existing `bun test` CI job so a regression of the loud-fail/never-fabricate guarantee fails CI before merge.
